ui.tagline: YouTube Music for desktop, with Discord Rich Presence.

update.title: Updates
update.body: Takaro {latest} is available. You have {current}. Update now? The app restarts on its own.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.note: Install extensions from the Chrome Web Store or Edge Add-ons. Extensions that change pages (blockers, themes, tweaks) work best; toolbar popups aren't available in Takaro.
extensions.installed: {name} installed. Reload Takaro to use it.
extensions.updated: {name} updated. Reload Takaro to use it.

sponsorblock.name: SponsorBlock
sponsorblock.description: Skips intros, outros and non-music parts of music videos, using the SponsorBlock database.

options.applyOnce: Only for the first song after opening the app

resume-session.name: Resume last session
resume-session.description: When the app opens, goes back to the song, playlist or mix you were listening to, at the same point.

options.restoreTime: Resume from where the song stopped

precise-volume.name: Precise volume
precise-volume.description: Change the volume with the mouse wheel over the player bar and with the ↑/↓ arrow keys.

options.arrowsShortcut: Use the ↑/↓ arrow keys for volume

playback-speed.name: Playback speed
playback-speed.description: Adds a speed control (0.07× to 16×) to the ⋮ menu of the player bar. Use the mouse wheel for fine adjustments.
playback-speed.label: Speed

quality-changer.name: Quality selector
quality-changer.description: Adds a button over the player to choose the video/audio quality.

video-toggle.name: Video or cover
video-toggle.description: Choose what the player shows: the music video, only the cover art, or nothing at all.

display.hidden: Nothing (hide the player, queue on full page)
